about: SKIR2 (2026-11-11, second run): probes on the off-band fights after the first run (scratch tool: one deck at N games via tools/skir1/fit_2026_11_11.js measure; tune seeds 11300 + 37g unless --seed 9100, the road seeds). contrib = a card’s copies swapped for a filler (earthworm etc., not legal: a probe); decks = whole decks with their legality; swapin = one card’s copies for each candidate. Applied picks: 4-5, 19-4, 20-10 (decks_2026_11_11.js set). Side maps (batches 11-18): applied 0-B-3, 1-A-2, 2-A-4; tried and reverted 10-A-1 / 10-A-4 / 10-A-5 (the Sunken Depths mix rule needs its two Lumber makers and cost-0 cards in its decks, and those make the 3-Lumber cards playable: 10-A-4 read 0-2% with any of them) and 11-A-3 (not 2+ points nearer once Gale Swift, its map’s only no-Wait card, stays for the mix).
